No gross face/body collapse; independent separate brown lower cheek/jaw patch has wing and chest influence and fails in source and battle. Remove that lower-jaw drift while preserving eyes, complete beak, headband/tails, scarf, feathered torso, wings, legs/claws and full tail.
All 13 body and head clips visually inspected. Eyes, beak and skull keep their shape; original dense anatomical check passes. No source repair needed; final double check pending.

All 24 enlarged source/battle slices actually inspected, with original head detail and brightness-2.5 body analysis copies plus bright battle side-head detail. No gross body collapse; the lower black cheek/chin and beak have residual neck/chest influence and fail independent measurements in both assets. Preserve eyes, full beak/jaw, headband/tails, blue scarf, white chest/shoulder feathers, wings, long legs/claws and full tail.

Source lower cheek/chin and scarf/chest distortion confirmed across all 24 enlarged source/battle first-pass slices. Face-only and local rigid/smoothed scarf candidates were rejected. The separately reviewed baseline battle binding resolves the scarf breakthrough; project that pinned binding onto all original detailed source vertices. Preserve sculpt, normals, UVs, topology, textures, rig and animation curves. The final broader skull probe detected a tiny rim interpolation at vertex 10828; retain all previously reviewed rigid skull-core vertices after reference transfer.
